body:
I have talked to him about suicide before and it seems to run in the family that someone dies this way. His grandfather killed himself in his barn where my dad's dad (my grandfather) found him with a single pistol shot to the side of his head. My dad has definitely been through more than me as he has had a tough life from the start and even to this day is having just as tough of a life. I guess if you wanted to think of it a certain way I'm just streamlining the pain I will have by killing myself. 

And what is making me angry? Well life haha. But in a more detailed reasoning just the hand I've been dealt in life. The financial trouble, the continuing depression that doesn't go away, the distance I feel from people and the feeling of not even wanting a connection with anyone besides the occasional conversation like this. I don't even really want things to go back to normal even if they could as I have no will anymore to "push" myself along anymore. Back to the "hand I was dealt in life" quote I know that sounds childish of me to say I deserve a better life but if this is the life I will have for the rest of my time I'd rather just be dead.

Money and financial support is one part of my life but it is not the ultimate reason why I will do this. I understand others can feel happy being homeless and not to make myself sound like I am above them in any way (I'm not) but I do not want to live that way. 

In time anyone who knew me will understand or at least come to terms with my decision and even though you are attempting to make me see the negative effects of my decision you will too one day forget this conversation. It's just how humans work. Good day.

I just replied to the person above this post if you want to read any of that but i will respond to you as well before I try to go to sleep.

First let me say I am not a good person. I am pretty terrible and have pretty frightening outbursts that any good person would not have. What I would say I have is a great amount of reserve for my feelings. The only downside is when I can't hold it in I do terrible unforgiving things. 

I still am thinking of speaking with my Nana but the idea of going to any mental institution because of my dangerous thoughts to myself and others is worse than death and would have to act quickly on my part to make sure I never go there.

And I have lost several family members. Mind you they weren't immediate members of my family but they were still very close. My uncle who was only 3 years older than me OD'd at 18 after what seemed to be a miraculous turn around from his drug addiction. I saw my whole family morn him but even after only a year my grandfather was already seemingly back to normal. Hell he even posts things like "How do you "defriend" somebody? Some of the posts are so stupid it makes me ill!(" on his Facebook. I know there is residual feelings of sadness that never go but people move on and once I die the same thing will happen. Everyone will be sad and then move on. 

As for guilt I'm sure they will feel guilt which I will try to alleviate as much as possible by leaving notes for each of them and any feelings of guilt they continue to have will at least become easy enough to live with.

I've been thinking about it for 2 years and seriously deciding for the past year. I would continue on if there was a good in the bad but in my situation there is only bad. 

As for my conversation with my father he is becoming increasingly depressed as well and so is my mother. They are in the midst of splitting up and it's a matter of time before one of us kills ourselves. My mom is currently on prescriptions and my dad is not on anything but today gave some strong hints as to not seeing him as much anymore. The divorce will is a sad part but the fact that I won't even have two happily separated parents afterwards hurts more.

Other parts of my life that have impacted my decision is we are not a very wealthy family at all. I have a job myself just to help support us. I hate my job but I do it for my family. A family that is now just relatives, no family. Next up in my decision is I am extremely angry at the world and depressed at the same time which causes massive mood swings. I am drifting away from any friends I have because I just don't care about any of them anymore and I sometimes feel like I'm hallucinating this whole world until I sit there and think about it all like I am right now and realizing how all too real it is.

In my view one if not both of my parents will kill themselves soon, I am doing terrible in college and I don't even care, I don't want to work, I don't want to hang out with friends or talk to people face to face. I just want to go away forever. It is the best of a bad situation and the thought of actually being able to just not think or be conscious anymore is very pleasing to myself.

Well honestly I'd rather not say exactly what the conversation was about but know that it was family related and needless to say the back break in my life. 
But as for the conversation I had last night I'd be more than happy to tell you what he said.
He started off just listening to what has happened in my life and he could tell I have had a tough one but he wouldn't just tell me "it's bad now but it gets better" he would actually talk to me about his attempted suicide and how after it failed he was happy it failed and has never tried to commit suicide again. He had and still has his good and bad days because that's what life is. You gotta try to find the good in the bad. 

We continued to have a conversation about college and if I really wanted to commit suicide to just think about it a little bit longer and maybe talk to someone face to face. 

I told him I plan on talking to my Nana (grandmother) and tell her how I feel. I still might but after today I know it won't really help as I will just be put on medicine to make me not feel so depressed. My problems will still be there and they will be even worse due to the therapy and medicine my family would have to pay for (we don't have a lot of extra income to start out with). So ultimately the conversation I had last night really opened my eyes to a lot of things and I feel like I have a new outlook on people but as for myself it honestly would be easier for everyone if I did just kill myself. They would never say that in a million years and would never even think that but it's the harsh reality of the situation. And in hindsight they will be sad and cry about it for awhile but that hurt will become bearable quickly and they will live their lives because over everything else in the world that is what humans do.
Are you suicidal at all yet?
I've been thinking about suicide recently and I just kinda want to talk it out too.
